overview: France is an attractive destination for students looking to **study postgraduate in computer engineering,** computer science, embedded systems, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity and advanced computing technologies. French universities and engineering schools provide specialized **master's programs** that integrate theoretical knowledge with practical projects and research opportunities.
****Edu Hawk worldwide** study abroad guidance** helps the students to explore these opportunities and know the requirements to pursue education abroad.

sections.title: 1. Can I do PG in computer engineering in France after BTech or BE?

items: Yes. A relevant **BTech or BE** can make you eligible to apply for a **master's program in computer engineering**, **computer science**, **embedded systems** or related fields. Entry is determined by your academic history and the programme’s entry requirements.

sections.title: 2. What is the duration of PG in computer engineering in France?

items: A national Master’s degree is usually two years after the relevant bachelor’s degree. Some programs offer applicants who meet the advanced-entry criteria direct entry to second-year status

sections.title: 3. Can I do a PG in computer engineering in France in English?

items: Yes. Some institutes, such as **Grenoble INP – Ensimag**, offer **master’s programs in computer science and related disciplines taught in English**.

sections.title: 4. What are the computer engineering PG tuition fees in France?

items: For **2026-2027**, the public-university Master's reference fee is **€255 per year** for eligible French and EU students and **€3,950 per year** for non-EU students subject to differentiated fees. Different prices may apply for Specialized international programs and private institutions.

sections.title: 5. After doing PG in computer engineering in France, what kind of jobs can I get?

items: Depending on your specialization, career options may include **software engineering**, **embedded systems**, **cybersecurity**, **cloud infrastructure**, **computer architecture**, **artificial intelligence**, **robotics**, and **research and development**.

Students should check the **degree awarded** and its recognition status before enrolling.

A **Master’s degree** is a degree in the French and European system of higher education. A *Diplôme d’ingénieur* is a separate qualification and its current authorization and accreditation should be checked with the **Commission des titres d’ingénieur (CTI)**, where appropriate.
Check the following prior to applying:
* The exact title of the degree and the institution that granted it.
* Whether the degree is a **national Master’s** or a **engineering diploma**.
* Duration of the program and ECTS credits.
* Current **accreditation status**, if applicable.
*  Internship and research possibilities.
* Admission to doctoral study or to further professional education.
**Postgraduate computer engineering graduates in **France**** can find jobs in software, computing infrastructure, embedded technologies, digital security and research.
Potential **job roles in computer engineering**.
* **Computer Engineering.**
* Software Development Engineer.**
* Embedded systems engineer**
* Architect of computer systems.**
* Engineer, Cybersecurity**
* Infrastructure or cloud engineer.**
* Artificial intelligence engineer.**
* Engineer in robotics and automation.
* - Systems and network engineer.**
* **Engineer, Research and Development.**
****Documents required to apply for post graduation in computer engineering in France**** are normally:
* Passport in order
* Certificate of Bachelor’s degree** or provisional certificate.
* Certified copies of academic transcripts.
* Curriculum vitae (CV).
* Statement of purpose (SOP)** or motivation letter.
* Results of English or French test**, if applicable.
* Letters of recommendation (if requested).
* Certified translations of documents where appropriate.
* Portfolio, programming projects or research proposal, if applicable.
* Application form and proof of payment, if applicable.
* Financial and visa documents** at the appropriate time.
